about: Five golden examples for the triage prompt. All senders, amounts and references are made up. Evaluate every prompt change with: python scripts/eval_golden.py

examples.name: Bank debit alert with a long reference number

email.subject: Rs. 2,499.00 debited from your account XX1234
email.snippet: Dear customer, INR 2,499.00 was debited on 25/11 for UPI txn ref 627153940211 to Sample Store.

email.subject: Can you review the grid study by Friday?
email.snippet: Hi, could you go through section 4 of the study and send comments before Friday? Thanks.

email.subject: This week in onshore wind: grid code updates
email.snippet: Five stories on turbine certification and grid connection rules. Read online.

email.subject: Flat 50% off - last chance this weekend
email.snippet: Exclusive deal on headphones. Free shipping. Ends Sunday.

email.subject: Invoice overdue
